transfer_provisions.quote: A Federal Environmental Executive designated by the President shall head the Office of the Federal Environmental Executive, which shall be maintained in the Environmental Protection Agency for funding and administrative purposes.
transfer_provisions.note: EO 13423 sets up its own Steering Committee (sec. 4(a)), OMB instruction duty (sec. 5) and Federal Environmental Executive (sec. 6), and restates agency goals on energy, water, acquisition, waste, buildings, fleets and electronics (sec. 2). These are new duties under the new order, not a savings or transfer clause for the revoked orders: sec. 11 carries no wording that keeps any revoked provision, action or position in force.

exceptions.quote: Executive Order 13134 of August 12, 1999, as amended;
exceptions.note: The only qualifier in the revocation list is 'as amended' after EO 13134 (amended in part by EO 13225 sec. 3(a)). It narrows nothing: EO 13101, 13123, 13148 and 13149 are each revoked without qualifier or exception.

effective_date_reading: Sec. 11(a) says 'The following are revoked' and lists EO 13101 (i), 13123 (ii), 13134 as amended (iii), 13148 (iv) and 13149 (v). Secs. 1-11 read in full: no effective-date, delayed-effect, transition or 'on the date of this order' wording attaches to sec. 11(a). The only dated or timed wording is 'within 30 days after the date of this order' (sec. 3(d)), 'after the date of this order' (secs. 3(e), 3(f)) and 'January 1 of each year through and including 2010' (sec. 11(b), a DoD report). None qualifies the revocations, so they took effect on signing, January 24, 2007 (printed 72 FR 3919-3923, January 26, 2007).

targets_in_batch_06.EO:13134: sec. 11(a)(iii) ('Executive Order 13134 of August 12, 1999, as amended')

other_provisions_noted: Sec. 11(b) is a stand-alone Department of Defense reporting duty through 2010 and sec. 11(c) amends EO 13327 sec. 3(b)(vi) (replacing the citation of EO 13148); neither saves any revoked clause. EO 13149 (sec. 11(a)(v)) is not in this batch.
conclusion: EO 13423 (signed 2007-01-24, 72 FR 3919, PDF pages 1-5, read once in full) sets agency goals and duties for energy, water, acquisition, waste, buildings, fleets and electronics (secs. 2-6), limits and exempts (secs. 7-8), defines terms (sec. 9), disclaims rights (sec. 10) and in sec. 11(a) revokes EO 13101, 13123, 13134 (as amended), 13148 and 13149 by number without savings, pending-matter, transition or effective-date wording. It restates much of the revoked orders' substance as new duties of its own (successor order), but it contains no clause that continues any revoked provision.
